description: Return all bridge descriptions for a piece — the full connection topology without neighborhood metadata. Useful for scanning all edges from a node before deciding which to follow. Each bridge is asymmetric: 'from_here' reads the neighbor through this piece's lens, 'from_there' reads this piece through the neighbor's lens. Sorted by strength descending. Use traverse() instead if you also want neighbor kernels and shared principles.

min_strength.description: Only return connections at or above this strength (default 0.0 = all)

name: get_connections
